description: Check the DNS of a custom domain now and return its status and records. Status: pending_dns (records not seen yet), verifying (DNS found, HTTPS being issued), active (live). Addressed by publication (type, namespace, id; an owner token in the profile) or by hostname (an admin token of the profile). Checks are spaced: a repeat too soon answers 429 with Retry-After.

hostname.description: Custom domain, e.g. www.example.com; instead of type, namespace and id

ownerToken.description: By publication: an owner token in the profile. By hostname: an admin token of the profile. Default: env BREWPAGE_OWNER_TOKEN (local server only).

type.description: Publication type; with namespace and id, instead of hostname

name: check_domain
title: Check custom domain DNS
